data.name: Parameswar
data.gender_notes: Parameswar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Parameswar is derived from Sanskrit, where Para means supreme and Ishwar means lord. This name signifies the ultimate deity, the supreme ruler of the universe. The name Parameswar carries the meaning “Supreme Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parameswar usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in devotion and spirituality.
data.etymology: Parameswar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parameswar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
